validation_category: Read-only source/data comparison; no new guest execution

historical_evidence.boundary: The actual native r4 four runs and46 checks remain bound to their original sources; source equivalence neither creates a new guest PASS nor admits browser execution.

retained_snapshot_verification.scope: Independently retained snapshots selected by the original r4 complete-file hashes. No claim is made that the two snapshots form one retained served-site directory.

registry_identity.difference_scope: firmwareProfiles execution/provenance variants only; every other field of the entire registry compares equal after removing that property from each profile

profile_module_identity.difference_scope: Execution/variant schema, validation, binding and argument generation differ; the two output functions below remain byte-identical

non_variant_registry_projection.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted keys, compact separators

native_output_projection.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted keys, compact separators

platform/web/public-qemu-servo.js.scope: Historical export/current bytes agree; no new source hash is attributed to r4's original inventory.

actual_native_call_path: public.js selects StackChan deviceId/board/outputs and the actual service-imported full-Flash SHA
PublicSessionController validates calibration and firmware/session/QOM receipt identity
public-qemu-servo.js validates raw source/registers and maps observed present_position to viewer commands
call_path_note: Native SCS polling imports validateQemuServoState directly. Its StackChan validateQemuOnboardState branch delegates to the same validator without calling the changed full execution-profile validator. The complete public.js/controller/config bytes remain at the actual r4 pins.
withdrawn_factory_variant: No Factory execution metadata is inherited into native output projection or the unchanged delivery path. Changed whole-file hashes are recorded without rewriting r4's historical source pins.

checks: raw r4 status and46 boolean checks

limits: No new native guest, browser runtime, whole-profile-module equivalence or product stability PASS.
Original r4 inputs, raw logs, runtime, source pins and results are preserved; current hashes are not substituted into that execution.
Source/data comparison covers the native delivery path above, not browser scheduler/variant admission or a fresh runtime.
redaction: No credentials, endpoints, host paths, raw session/target/device identifiers, binaries or raw observations.
